# Compare versions

Choose two versions to see how the statement has changed. Dated bullet points explain the edits. Sections are matched by heading, so changes in order do not hide edits to the wording.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from scripts.mission_site import load_versions, comparison_page

# All comparisons are calculated here with Python's standard library.
# Dated editorial summaries are read from CHANGELOG.md.
# The rendered HTML contains the data and works without a server or an API.
print(comparison_page(load_versions()))
```
